paragraphs: At shift change, they review the day's loading plan and documents, connect the loading arm at the station, and perform a leak test. During loading, they monitor pressure and level curves to prevent spills and overfilling. At shipside, they calculate loading plans and control flow rates. After loading, they measure and seal the shipment, clear the area, and hand over the shift. They maintain records throughout and stop operations immediately when an alarm appears.
